201:t_004:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm taking back the peace you stole from everyone!」

201:t_004:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Both the $$翠の地球$$ and the $$蒼の地球$$...!」

201:t_004:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The time to settle this through dialogue is already past!」

201:t_004:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「We're coming through! By force, if we have to!」

201:t_004:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin the attack! First, we break through the defense line!」

201:t_004:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「In this battle, we strike the very heart of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

201:t_004:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Roger, $n! We're coming back alive, no matter what!」

201:t_004:16.en:
$n
「But I'll give it everything I've got!」

201:t_005:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「We've broken through the defense line!」

201:t_005:1.en:
$$シン$$
「All that's left is to charge into the Imperial Palace!」

201:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like the main event has arrived.」

201:t_007:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$...! And $$バルビエル$$, too!」

201:t_007:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I knew it, the two Reactors were here!」

201:t_007:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That battleship at the very back...」

201:t_007:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Don't tell me that one is also...!」

201:t_007:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Is it a $$スフィア・リアクター$$!?」

201:t_007:11.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「She's not much of a talker. Allow us to introduce her.」

201:t_007:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you're the one introducing her, $$ストラウス$$ is finished.」

201:t_007:14.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「The name $$ダバラーン・タウ$$ mentioned...」

201:t_007:15.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「She is Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$. True to that title, she is the top commander of all $$新地球皇国$$ forces.」

201:t_007:16.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「At the same time, she is also the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the $$欲深な金牛$$.」

201:t_007:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「So she's their top military leader...!」

201:t_007:20.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Then the ship she's aboard must be the Empire's flagship.」

201:t_007:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「Fine by me! I'll blast away everything that comes out!」

201:t_007:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll crush their Supreme Commander before I get to the Emperor!」

201:t_007:24.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm telling you, it's useless.」

201:t_007:25.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You have already fallen into $$ストラウス$$'s trap.」

201:t_007:27.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What'll you do? Turn back?」

201:t_007:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But you can't, can you? You're carrying everyone's hopes.」

201:t_007:30.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Since you've trampled into the imperial capital with muddy boots, we will exterminate you.」

201:t_007:31.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't talk about people like they're bugs!」

201:t_007:32.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「They are lives all the same. There is no difference.」

201:t_007:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To think the meaning of words could change this much depending on who says them.」

201:t_007:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「But we're here with a resolve of our own, too...!」

201:t_007:35.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! If we don't defeat the Reactors, we can't reach the Imperial Palace!」

201:t_007:38.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't need to hear your orders. We'll dispose of these guys right here.」

201:t_007:41.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... Please get ready to escape.」

201:t_008:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This power... it's on a whole other level!」

201:t_008:1.en:
$n
「So this is how serious they are...!」

201:t_008:4.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! A unit is approaching this area at high speed!」

201:t_009:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's... the one that should have been sealed in Mars's 《$$ＺＯＮＥ$$》...」

201:t_009:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's been a while, $$セツコ$$. And $$ランド$$, too.」

201:t_009:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's a shame $$クロウ$$ isn't here, but I see there's a new Reactor.」

201:t_009:0 / t_009:1 / t_009:3: Rand/Setsuko/Garrod reactions to the unit, no subject stated in source ('That's...!', 'But there's no mistake!')
